notes.subject: bekim yu
notes.rationale: פדה em i stretim mani bilong bekim man; 'bekim' i klousup, Hebrew i tok 'rausim man long ses bilong mani'

notes.subject: han bilong
notes.rationale: כף em i holim han (palm); mi usim 'han' wantaim 'יד' long wanpela pasin

notes.subject: רעים / ערצים
notes.rationale: Tupela tok i wok long klostu wankain nois, parallelism namel long tupela hap bilong ves

translation: Na bai mi pulim yu ausait long han bilong ol man bilong nogut, na bai mi bekim yu long han bilong ol bikpela man nogut i gat strong.
